name: Simple Java Mail
tagline: Simple to use. Built for the real world.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Send email from Java with a small fluent API and built-in support for security, shared configuration, diagnostics, conversion, batching, clusters, and proxies.

pages.title: Why Simple Java Mail
pages.description: Your code should describe the email, not build a MIME tree. See what Simple Java Mail handles and where Jakarta Mail still fits.

pages.title: Documentation
pages.description: Find guides and reference docs by what you need to do: build, configure, secure, send, troubleshoot, or extend.

pages.title: Capabilities
pages.description: Build messages and recipients, send them, convert them, validate them, and drop down to Jakarta Mail when needed.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.description: Configure mailers in Java, property files, environment variables, or Spring, including defaults, overrides, pools, and clusters.

pages.title: Security
pages.description: Configure TLS, OAuth2, server verification, DKIM, S/MIME, and protection against header injection.

pages.title: Diagnostics
pages.description: Test SMTP connections, inspect the settings in use, route debug output, understand failures, and read server replies.

pages.title: Modules
pages.description: Choose only the extra modules you need: batching, authenticated SOCKS, DKIM, S/MIME, Outlook, CLI, Spring, OSGi, or Karaf.

pages.title: Command-line interface
pages.description: Send, validate, and test mail settings from the command line with the same options exposed by the Java builders.

pages.title: MIME and interoperability
pages.description: Understand why MIME structure matters, what malformed nesting looks like in mail clients, and how Simple Java Mail builds the message tree.

pages.title: Compare approaches
pages.description: Compare Simple Java Mail with Jakarta Mail, Spring Mail, and Apache Commons Email by what each one handles for you.

pages.title: Get started
pages.description: Install Simple Java Mail from Maven Central, send a first email, verify the SMTP connection, and choose optional modules.

pages.title: Migration notes
pages.description: Choose migration guidance for Simple Java Mail releases that change APIs or defaults.

pages.title: Migrating to 9.2
pages.description: Migration guidance for builder API changes, asynchronous failures, serialized email snapshots, configuration precedence, TLS trust, embedded-image containment, DKIM validation, and S/MIME status in Simple Java Mail 9.2.

pages.title: Migrating to 9.0
pages.description: Breaking changes and migration guidance for Simple Java Mail 9.0.

pages.title: Migrating to 8.0
pages.description: Migration guidance for the email-governance, validation, conversion, DKIM, S/MIME, and parser changes introduced in Simple Java Mail 8.0.

pages.title: Migrating to 7.0
pages.description: Historical migration guidance for Simple Java Mail 7.0.

pages.title: Migrating to 6.0
pages.description: Historical migration guidance for Simple Java Mail 6.0.

pages.title: Migrating to 5.0
pages.description: Historical migration guidance for Simple Java Mail 5.0.

pages.title: Help and contribute
pages.description: Find out where to ask a question, report a bug, suggest a feature, improve the docs, or contribute code.
